# Thermostat (`thermostat`)

Target temperature or range with − / +, current reading, mode and what it is doing.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createThermostat` (types in `dist/web/home/thermostat.d.ts`): `.mh-thermostat`: the target big between − / + buttons (`__target` groups, `--low | --high` for a heat-and-coolrange, each with `__adjust`, `__step` buttons and an `__value` output of `__number` and `__unit`), then`__status` with the `__current` reading and the `__action` hint (`--heating | --cooling | --drying | --fan |--idle | --off`), then the `__mode` control. Taps change the number at once and `onTarget` fires once theysettle (and on `destroy` if still waiting). Modifiers `--compact`, `--range`; state `.is-disabled`.

```ts
export function createThermostat(options: ThermostatOptions): ThermostatHandle;

export interface ThermostatOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the whole control (default "Thermostat"). */
  label?: string;
  /** The measured temperature. */
  current?: number | null;
  /** The single target; ignored when both `targetLow` and `targetHigh` are numbers. */
  target?: number | null;
  targetLow?: number | null;
  targetHigh?: number | null;
  /** Shown after the numbers (default "°C"); any string. */
  unit?: string;
  /** Default 7. */
  min?: number;
  /** Default 35. */
  max?: number;
  /** One tap of − / + (default 0.5); also sets the decimals shown. */
  step?: number;
  mode?: string;
  /** Up to four become a segmented control, more a select. */
  modes?: readonly ThermostatMode[];
  action?: ThermostatAction | null;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Smaller type and controls, for small cards. */
  compact?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<ThermostatLabels>;
  /** Idle time after the last tap before `onTarget` fires, in ms (default 700). */
  delay?: number;
  /** The new target (or range), once the taps settle. */
  onTarget?: (value: ThermostatTarget) => void;
  onMode?: (value: string) => void;
}

export interface ThermostatHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. A target still being tapped stays on screen. */
  update(changes: Partial<ThermostatOptions>): void;
  /** Sends a target that is still waiting for the taps to settle. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface ThermostatLabels {
  /** Name of a single target's group. */
  target: string;
  /** Name (and visible label) of a range's lower end. */
  low: string;
  /** Name (and visible label) of a range's upper end. */
  high: string;
  lower: string;
  raise: string;
  /** Before the current reading ("Now 19.5°C"). */
  now: string;
  mode: string;
  heating: string;
  cooling: string;
  drying: string;
  fan: string;
  idle: string;
  off: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createThermostat } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const thermostat = createThermostat({
  label: 'Living room thermostat',
  current: 19.5,
  target: 21,
  mode: 'heat',
  modes: [
    { value: 'off', label: 'Off' },
    { value: 'heat', label: 'Heat' },
    { value: 'cool', label: 'Cool' },
  ],
  action: 'heating',
  // Called once the taps settle, so one change is sent rather than one per tap.
  onTarget: (target) => {
    if (typeof target === 'number') thermostat.update({ target });
  },
  onMode: (mode) => thermostat.update({ mode, action: mode === 'off' ? 'off' : 'idle' }),
});

document.body.append(thermostat.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Thermostat } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const MODES = [
  { value: 'off', label: 'Off' },
  { value: 'heat', label: 'Heat' },
  { value: 'cool', label: 'Cool' },
];

export function ThermostatExample() {
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(21);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('heat');
  return (
    <Thermostat
      label="Living room thermostat"
      current={19.5}
      target={target}
      mode={mode}
      modes={MODES}
      action={mode === 'off' ? 'off' : 'heating'}
      // Called once the taps settle, so one change is sent rather than one per tap.
      onTarget={(value) => {
        if (typeof value === 'number') setTarget(value);
      }}
      onMode={setMode}
    />
  );
}
```
